intent: Controlled-state variants for the final seven original neutral-dwelling landmarks; preserve each exact base identity while making active muster readiness legible on the overworld.
shared_prompt_constraints: Preserve exact base architecture, perspective, proportions, palette, and painterly strategy-map rendering.
Add only restrained active-muster cues such as open access, ordered supplies, lit work areas, teal-and-ivory claim cloth, and ready equipment.
No people, creatures, words, labels, UI, background, ground plane, border, copied franchise elements, or protected visual expression.
Retain genuine transparent alpha outside the object and generous transparent margins.
alpha_recovery: Three generated edits returned a baked pale checkerboard after the model background-extraction pass. Only the border-connected near-neutral field was removed with a 10 percent flood-fill tolerance. All seven final sources and the runtime atlas retain transparent corners.
